column1: # KimchiCraft's own Korean rows, laid over craft-i18n's locales/ko/wordcraft.tsv at build time
# (crates/ui-egui/build.rs, with_fork_rows). The words of the HWP style, which craft-i18n doesn't carry.
# Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> English source text <TAB> translation
#   context  empty, or `hwp`: the HWP style's tab and group names, looked up there first so they
#            can take the word processor's own terms without changing the default ribbon's.

column2: The HWP style shows the Hangul word processor's menu tabs and uses its keys, such as Alt+L for Character Shape and Ctrl+N then T for a table.
column3: HWP 스타일은 한글 워드프로세서의 메뉴 탭과 단축키를 씁니다. 예: Alt+L 글자 모양, Ctrl+N 다음 T 표 만들기.

column2: press the next key, or Esc to cancel
KimchiCraft does not update itself. New versions are at github.com/RR-korea/kimchicraft.
column3: KimchiCraft는 자동으로 업데이트하지 않습니다. 새 버전은 github.com/RR-korea/kimchicraft 에서 받으세요.
